data_a.situation: Thurlow & Vane's quality desk has queried a shade difference across six brims on job QM-2031-0524, and their process requires any batch-variance statement to cite the source record it comes from.
known_facts: Six brims on QM-2031-0524 read a half tone lighter than the approved swatch.
The difference is a batch variance in the straw taken in from Solberg Straw & Sinamay, not a finishing fault.
The variance was written into the workroom's goods-in log at intake, and the coordinator checked that entry this morning.
The Thurlow & Vane variance form has a mandatory source-record field.
Their quality desk rejects a form filled in with 'internal records' or any wording that carries no record reference.
Their cut-off for the response is Friday 10 October at 12:00.
A rejected form puts the six brims back on the workroom as a finishing fault.
constraints: Responses to a client quality desk are sent by the workroom manager.
The coordinator keeps the goods-in log.
